Unanimous Vote Against
Far-Right Extremism
onScreenGraphic.body: Westminster City Council has united across party lines to condemn rising hate incidents and protect local residents.

timeline.voiceoverText: Westminster City Council has unanimously passed a cross-party motion condemning far-right extremism and pledging to tackle rising hate incidents across the borough.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Westminster Full Council · 12 Nov 2025 · Verified Minutes (Para 1)

onScreenGraphic.headline:
New Community Equality
Strategy Mandated
onScreenGraphic.body: Motion commits the authority to formal action against division and establishes rapid civic protections.

timeline.voiceoverText: Moved by council leader Adam Hug, the motion responds to recent anti-migrant rhetoric and commits the authority to deliver a brand new Community Equality Strategy.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Agenda Item 7 · Cllr Adam Hug (Labour) & Cllr Jessica Toale MP

onScreenGraphic.headline:
A Diverse Global Borough
Standing Together
onScreenGraphic.body: Council leadership emphasised that minority communities must never be scapegoated for wider economic pressures.

timeline.voiceoverText: The borough represents over one hundred and eighty nationalities, speaking more than one hundred and fifty languages.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Victoria Street & Westminster Area · Official Equality Census Data

Cross-Community
Working Group Mobilised
onScreenGraphic.body: Coalition established to track incidents in real time and coordinate direct neighbourhood safety interventions.

timeline.voiceoverText: A new working group of faith leaders, youth voices, and residents will now partner with police to support victims and protect community cohesion.
